# NativeCurrencyPaymentFallback

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/58e088ac53759285525112de9eee810ef2094dce/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/common/NativeCurrencyPaymentFallback.sol)

**Title:** NativeCurrencyPaymentFallback - A contract that has a fallback to accept native currency payments.

**Author:** Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

## Functions

<a id="receive"></a>

### receive

Receive function accepts native currency transactions.

<i>

Emits an event with sender and received value.

</i>

```solidity
receive() external payable;
```

## Events

### SafeReceived

```solidity
event SafeReceived(address indexed sender, uint256 value);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| sender | `address` |  |
| value | `uint256` |  |
